thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 10/25/2018: TWTR, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/25/2018: TWTR, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +3.25%
AAPL: +1.52%
IBM: +0.87%
CSCO: +1.59%
GOOG: +1.99%
Technology stocks were rallying in Thursday's pre-market trading .
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Twitter ( TWTR ), which was up by more than 13% as the social network company announced non-GAAP diluted earnings of $0.21 per share, more than double the $0.10 booked last year. The result topped the $0.14 mean from analysts polled by Capital IQ.
(-) Advanced Micro Devices' ( AMD ) was down by 18% even as its adjusted EPS rose to $0.13 in Q3 from $0.09 a year earlier, just ahead of analysts' estimates of $0.12 in a Capital IQ poll. Its revenue lagged the Street estimate.
(+) Microsoft ( MSFT ) was up by over 3% as it reported Q1 revenue was $29.1 billion, up 19% over year-ago levels and ahead of the analyst consensus of $27.9 billion on Capital IQ. Earnings were $1.14 per share, surging 36% over year ago levels and better than expectations of $0.96 per share.
